name: Semiconductor Support Services, Co
old_description: Our mission is to partner with our customers and enable them to sustain and improve their operations, using our high quality services and products.
about:
Semiconductor Support Services Co. (SSSco) was established in 2001 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas. The company operates offices across North America and maintains a global network of employees and partners.

SSSco delivers products and services for semiconductor wafer fabrication equipment, specializing in Applied Materials (AMAT), MKS, SMC, Lam Research, and Tokyo Electron (TEL) systems. Its offerings include the Penulator™ product family—remote, data, video, and single-board computer solutions—along with equipment upgrades, retrofits, repair services, training, and on-site support. The company maintains a large inventory of OEM and alternative qualified parts, and operates a repair center and upgrade center.

The company serves semiconductor manufacturers and equipment operators that run AMAT, MKS, SMC, Lam, and TEL wafer fab platforms. Its customers include fabs seeking productivity gains, obsolescence solutions, and sustained equipment performance through upgrades, repairs, and spare parts.

SSSco states its mission is to partner with customers to sustain and improve their operations through high-quality services and products, emphasizing rapid response with the tagline “When it has to be right…now.”
